reference_sql:
SELECT store_id, city, opened_on,
  LAG(city) OVER (ORDER BY opened_on) AS prev_city
FROM stores
alternatives:
SELECT s.store_id, s.city, s.opened_on, p.city AS prev_city
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN stores p ON p.opened_on = (SELECT MAX(s2.opened_on) FROM stores s2 WHERE s2.opened_on < s.opened_on)

SELECT store_id, city, opened_on,
  LEAD(city) OVER (ORDER BY opened_on DESC) AS prev_city
FROM stores

other_way.sql:
SELECT s.store_id, s.city, s.opened_on, p.city AS prev_city
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN stores p ON p.opened_on = (SELECT MAX(s2.opened_on) FROM stores s2 WHERE s2.opened_on < s.opened_on)
other_way.tradeoff: Joining each store to the latest earlier opening works without a window, but the subquery in the join is harder to follow.
